boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented CSUMB settings for solo work, group sessions, computer access, tutoring, and hands-on projects, with current access conditions noted.

cards.entity_name: Tanimura & Antle Family Memorial Library Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve a Library Study Room
cards.subtitle: A bookable room for focused solo or group work
cards.notes: Reserve on the hour, plan for a two-hour limit, and arrive within 10 minutes so the room is not released for first-come use.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed, reservable workspace governed by a clear arrival and time-limit policy.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB states that current students may reserve library study rooms individually or in groups, with reservations starting on the hour and limited to two hours per day.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Only current CSUMB students may reserve and use these rooms. Reservations begin and end on the hour and have a two-hour daily limit.

cards.entity_name: Otter Student Union Group Study Room
cards.title: Book the OSU Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: A student-only room reserved through the information desk
cards.notes: Bring your student credentials, stop at the OSU information desk, and reserve this room when your group needs a defined workspace.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated group room inside the Otter Student Union with desk-managed reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Otter Student Union lists a Group Study Room that CSUMB students can reserve at the information desk.
cards.source_title: Services and Resources | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Restricted to CSUMB students; reserve at the Otter Student Union information desk.

cards.entity_name: Otter Student Union Student Lounge & Terrace
cards.title: Work from the OSU Lounge and Terrace
cards.subtitle: Flexible seating paired with Monterey Bay views
cards.notes: Choose the lounge for an informal work session or take materials onto the terrace; check OSU operations before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: An informal indoor-outdoor option suited to reading, planning, or laptop work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Otter Student Union identifies its Student Lounge & Terrace as a facility where visitors can relax with views of Monterey Bay.
cards.source_title: Services and Resources | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Otter Student Union building access and any event-related closures.

cards.entity_name: Tanimura & Antle Family Memorial Library Makerspace
cards.title: Develop Projects in the Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Tables, materials, and equipment for creative coursework
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from shared tables or specialty materials, then confirm current general-access hours or workshop requirements.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative library workspace supporting creative assignments and hands-on production.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB reports that students use the library Makerspace for class projects and studying; the documented space includes tables, desks, materials, and printing equipment.
cards.source_title: Students create crafts and community in the library's Makerspace | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Confirm current general-access hours or contact the Makerspace before relying on equipment; some activities may occur through scheduled workshops.

cards.entity_name: Tanimura & Antle Family Memorial Library First-Floor Computer Area
cards.title: Set Up at the First-Floor Computers
cards.subtitle: Desktop workstations for the CSUMB community
cards.notes: Use this area when an assignment needs a full desktop setup; follow posted computer-use signs and keep your OtterID available.
cards.short_summary: A practical library workstation zone for research, drafting, and online coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's New Student FAQ says desktop PCs are available to the CSUMB community on the library's first floor.
cards.source_title: New Student FAQ | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Desktop PCs are for the CSUMB community. Users must follow posted computer-use instructions and current library access rules.

cards.title: Use Room 2145 Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Student desktop access when instruction is not scheduled
cards.notes: Check whether library instruction is scheduled before settling in; use the room when you need a desktop for sustained course work.
cards.short_summary: A conditional-access computer classroom that doubles as student workspace between instruction sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB says desktop PCs in Information Literacy Room 2145 are available to students when no library instruction is scheduled.
cards.source_title: New Student FAQ | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Available to students only when library instruction is not scheduled; verify room availability on arrival.

cards.title: Study with Support at the CLC
cards.subtitle: Appointments, drop-ins, and subject-focused group sessions
cards.notes: Review the current subject schedule before going, then book when required or choose a listed drop-in period for targeted assignment help.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support setting for structured tutoring, writing help, and guided group study.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB's Fall 2026 schedule lists tutoring, Supplemental Instruction, group sessions, drop-ins, writing support, and peer coaching through the Cooperative Learning Center.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Schedule | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Consult the Fall 2026 schedule because some sessions require appointments while others are drop-in; hours and sessions are subject to change.

cards.title: Bring STEM Problems to Library 1176
cards.subtitle: A scheduled drop-in room for science support
cards.notes: Match your course to the published STEM Studio roster and arrive during its listed drop-in window with problems ready to work through.
cards.short_summary: A named library room hosting scheduled, course-specific STEM drop-in support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fall 2026 tutoring schedule places STEM Studio drop-ins for listed biology and environmental science courses in Library 1176.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Schedule | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Use during the published STEM Studio drop-in sessions for eligible courses; the schedule states that hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Work Through Quantitative Courses in S222
cards.subtitle: Scheduled drop-in study support in Chapman Science Academic Center
cards.notes: Check which math or statistics courses are covered that day, then bring practice problems to Chapman S222 during a listed café session.
cards.short_summary: A recurring drop-in destination for guided mathematics and statistics work.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB's Fall 2026 tutoring schedule lists Math/Stat Café drop-ins for specified mathematics and statistics courses in Chapman S222.
cards.source_title: Tutoring Schedule | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Attend only during a listed Math/Stat Café session and verify that the day's course coverage matches your class; schedules may change.

cards.entity_name: Tanimura & Antle Family Memorial Library Reference Area
cards.title: Research from the Reference Area
cards.subtitle: Library materials and public-access research computers
cards.notes: Set up near the reference collection when source-heavy work needs print materials or on-site access to the library's electronic collections.
cards.short_summary: A research-oriented library area combining reference materials with designated public computers.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB states that visitors may consult library books, periodicals, and reference materials and that public-access computers in the Reference Area provide access to electronic collections.
cards.source_title: General Public | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: On-site consultation and Reference Area computer access are available under library rules; remote access to licensed databases and ebooks is excluded for the general public.
